name: Contact 4
definition: Specifies the details of the contact person.

NamePrefix.name: Name Prefix
NamePrefix.definition: Specifies the terms used to formally address a person.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name by which a party is known and which is usually used to identify that party.

PhoneNumber.name: Phone Number
PhoneNumber.definition: Collection of information that identifies a phone number, as defined by telecom services.

MobileNumber.name: Mobile Number
MobileNumber.definition: Collection of information that identifies a mobile phone number, as defined by telecom services.

FaxNumber.name: Fax Number
FaxNumber.definition: Collection of information that identifies a FAX number, as defined by telecom services.

EmailPurpose.name: Email Purpose
EmailPurpose.definition: Purpose for which an email address may be used.

Responsibility.name: Responsibility
Responsibility.definition: Role of a person in an organisation.

Department.name: Department
Department.definition: Identification of a division of a large organisation or building.

PreferredMethod.name: Preferred Method
PreferredMethod.definition: Preferred method used to reach the contact.
